title: Expanded verb set: dive-roll, tic-tac, vault variants, wall-run (AUTH #021)
summary: Add the AUTH #021 verbs to the traversal controller on the shared GJ skeleton, tuned to the new movement.json constants (dive, ticTac, wallRun): dive-roll (committed forward dive chaining to a roll), tic-tac (wall kick for height/redirect), vault variants (kong/dash, speed, underbar), and wall-run (short run across a flat vertical >= 3A). Each registers through the existing layers; the reachability validator is made aware of the new transitions. Brain-B half (AT-2: the shared affordance model + the M1-SCEN-05 validator account for every new verb within the 0.85 margin) is built + proven; the Unity verb implementations + MoveClip tags (AT-1/AT-3) are gj-gameplay.
deliverables: services/traversal (affordance model + reachability coverage for the new verbs) [claude-builder, done]

acceptance_tests.test: Dive-roll, tic-tac, the vault variants, and wall-run are implemented on the shared skeleton and honor the movement.json constants (dive, ticTac, wallRun); wall-run only triggers on a flat vertical with >= 3A of run at run+ speed and exits cleanly to jump/mantle/fall.
The deterministic reachability validator (M1-SCEN-05) accounts for the new transitions so generated routes may use them within the 85% margin.
acceptance_tests.evidence: services/traversal/tests/test_verbs_expansion.py (13 green); also test_affordances.py (verb-tier == frozen schema), test_reach.py, test_graph.py (wall-run edge)

acceptance_tests.test: Each verb reads with real-body weight and platformer responsiveness (Bible §0 bar) on the Owner's iPhone.
